text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I thought it'd be nice to eat at a cafe… but, it turns out it's too crowded.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …How annoying. But I wasn't that hungry to begin with, so I guess it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I could prepare something in the middle of the night instead. Doesn't matter what it is, as long as I get the proper nutrition—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh, no way! I put on more weight again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why oh why? I've even been avoiding ramen for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I thought I was cutting back on the calories in my snacks after dinner too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: We have to eat right for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and refrain from eating late at night… That's…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want you to begin preparing my daily meals, with healthy proportions to boot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Make sure you're considering the proper times to serve them, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do as she says and begin preparing and delivering meals to the laboratory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the proper diet, Agnes Tachyon seems to feel more fit.
